svg.title: Roadmap: four phases, three gates, 18 months
svg.desc: Title: “Four phases take the community from charter to v1.0 standards in 18 months”. Phases not drawn to scale; diamonds are gates that must pass before the next phase. 1, Convene, months 0–3: Charter, conduct code; GitHub org and 3 WGs; Pledge text drafted. Gate: Charter ratified. 2, Draft, months 3–9: UEP process live; Zakat and waqf v0.1; Security baseline. Gate: First UEPs accepted. 3, Pilot, months 9–15: Pilot with 2–3 bodies; Reference software; Transparency logs live. Gate: Pilot results public. 4, Scale, months 15–18: Standards v1.0; First council election; Annual public report.
